title: Compromise of a SICAM 8 RTU through the maintenance network

attacker_profile.description: An external attacker with access to a compromised maintenance device or valid maintenance credentials.

entry_point.description: A temporarily connected engineering and maintenance device that provides access to the OT maintenance network.

target.description: A critical RTU and substation automation controller that processes operational data and control commands.

attack_path.name: Initial Access
attack_path.description: The attacker gains control of the maintenance laptop or uses compromised maintenance credentials.
required_conditions: The maintenance laptop is available to the attacker or has been compromised.
The maintenance laptop is connected during the maintenance operational state.

attack_path.name: Access to the Network Component
attack_path.description: Through the active maintenance or management connection, the attacker reaches the RUGGEDCOM RST2428P switch running SINEC OS.
required_conditions: The connection between the maintenance laptop and the switch is active.
The switch management interface is reachable from the maintenance connection.
The attacker satisfies the required authentication or access conditions.

attack_path.name: Manipulation or Bypass of Network Segmentation
attack_path.description: The attacker exploits an applicable weakness to modify or bypass network or access-control settings on the switch.
required_conditions: At least one applicable vulnerability or insecure configuration is associated with the switch.
The attacker has sufficient access to interact with the affected service or function.

attack_path.name: Lateral Movement
attack_path.description: After the network restrictions have been bypassed or modified, the SICAM 8 CPCI85 becomes reachable from the compromised network path.
required_conditions: The connection between the switch and the RTU is active.
Network controls no longer prevent communication with the RTU.
A service or protocol on the RTU is reachable.

attack_path.name: Compromise of the Control Component
attack_path.description: The attacker exploits an applicable vulnerability or insecure product function affecting the SICAM 8 CPCI85.
required_conditions: At least one applicable vulnerability or insecure function is associated with the RTU.
The deployed product version is affected.

attack_path.name: Impact
attack_path.description: The compromise impairs the availability or integrity of a protection, control, monitoring, or communication function.
required_conditions: The compromised function influences an operational or communication process.
Existing safety or recovery controls do not prevent the resulting effect.

global_preconditions: The system is operating in the maintenance state.
The maintenance laptop is connected to the RUGGEDCOM switch.
The RUGGEDCOM switch is connected to the SICAM 8 CPCI85.
The relevant interfaces and connections are enabled.
Applicable vulnerabilities or insecure configurations are identified during the vulnerability lookup stage.
assumptions: This is a synthetic test scenario.
The attack path is not evidence that the complete chain has been observed in a real deployment.
Vulnerability identifiers and scores are maintained separately from the system component model.
A vulnerability may only enable an attack step when all of its technical prerequisites are satisfied.
